category_title: Elementary students with ASD and language delay who generalize virtual experiences to real-world social interactions
scenario_title: Distraction by Interactive Objects and Voice Chat
minimal_context: The student is placed outside a virtual convenience store for Lesson 2 and is expected to move inside to complete their assigned mission.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are starting Lesson 2 now. Please move into the convenience store to complete your mission.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stays outside the convenience store and begins playing with the objects nearby with peers instead of moving on to complete the tasks)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should do next?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Discovers the voice chat function and hears their own voice) Ahhh! Hello? Ahhh!

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Laughs loudly and continues making noises into the voice chat, playing with the objects outside with peers, with their attention totally distracted away from the learning process)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We are starting Lesson 2 now. Please move into the convenience store to complete your mission.

STUDENT: (Stays outside the convenience store and begins playing with the objects nearby with peers instead of moving on to complete the tasks)

TUTOR: What do you think you should do next?

STUDENT: (Discovers the voice chat function and hears their own voice) Ahhh! Hello? Ahhh!

TUTOR: Please focus on the lesson.

STUDENT: (Laughs loudly and continues making noises into the voice chat, playing with the objects outside with peers, with their attention totally distracted away from the learning process)

task.learning_goal: Successfully carried out the assigned mission

context.environment: Outside the exploration context of Lesson 2 (in a convenience store)
context.materials: Objects a great fun to play with their peers, voice chat function, text chat function
context.time_context: At the start of the learning activity

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Placed outside the exploration context of Lesson 2... near objects a great fun to play with
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Did not move on completing the tasks because they found those objects a great fun to play with their peers
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Attention was totally distracted away from the learning process

behavior_patterns.condition: When they found that they could hear their own and others’ voices
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Began to make noises, laugh and totally lose attention to learning activities
